answer: The protocol requires each AI agent to reserve 1 exclusive processing channel, acting as a lagoon for authorized traffic. An honest participant manages one reservation effectively, while an attacker seeking to spawn 1,000 identities must procure massive labor for infrastructure to maintain parallel slots, akin to planting an orchard that requires constant, non-sharable attention. A verifier inspects the reef of logs for session occupancy; any overlap triggers instant, permanent access revocation.
